SHIFT_DATE,MAX(N1A1_ACT_SR)N1A1_ACT_SR ,MAX(N1A3_ACT_SR)N1A3_ACT_SR ,MAX(SR_TARGET)SR_TARGET FROM( SELECT SHIFT_DATE,EQP_G,FAB,ACT_SR,SR_TARGET ,CASE WHEN FAB ='N1A1' THEN ACT_SR END N1A1_ACT_SR ,CASE
